true_rule: active PIT classification is carried forward
authoritative historical regime establishes a subsequent expected update opportunity and normal official publication sequence
qualified successor should already have become available by decision time
no qualified successor is genuinely available by decision time
false_rule: qualified regime and publication sequence establish that no expected update opportunity was missed
unresolved_rule: regime, expected opportunity, or defensible availability implication cannot be established
prohibitions: period-end or archive-date substitution for availability
fabricated zero or one under unresolved regime
change to any other PV0 field
